selected_next_slice.title: R1 Prism report archive churn/freeze guard
scope: Define a machine-readable churn/freeze policy for Prism report archive planning.
Make planned formal Prism report additions explicit before live copy-first apply.
Provide an auto-refresh or frozen-window rule for P4-12/P4-13 report_count/hash drift.
Do not create private-archive/prism-reports live files.
Do not copy, move, delete, rename or replace report files.
Do not touch prism/runs raw evidence.
Do not claim prism-layer-and-evidence is closed.
minimum_acceptance: checker or script support for distinguishing planned report additions from unexpected drift
P4-12 and P4-13 snapshots refreshed to the current report set
Prism review by Claude Code and Kimi when available

adjudication.reason: Claude Code selected live copy-first apply. Kimi selected churn/freeze guard. Cap chose the smaller non-destructive guard first because the route-selection task itself adds a formal Prism report and repeats the exact report-set churn that could make live apply fragile.
adjudication.tie_breaker: When one option creates live archive files and another stabilizes the assumptions needed for that copy-first apply, choose the stabilizing non-destructive guard first unless a human asks to accelerate.
